blocks.text: Period mein baen se daen jate hue electronegativity barhti hai, kyun ke nuclear charge barhta hai aur size kam hota hai. Group mein oopar se neeche electronegativity kam hoti hai, kyun ke shells jurne se size barhta hai aur shielding effect bhi barhta hai. Maslan halogen group mein electronegativity fluorine (4.0) se iodine (2.5) tak kam hoti hai, jaisa ke Fig 1.8 mein periodic table ke ek hisse mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Periodic table ka hissa, Pauling electronegativity qeematon ke saath: oopar ke teer par H 2.1; Li 1.0, Be 1.5, B 2.0, C 2.5, N 3.0, O 3.5, F 4.0; Na 0.9, Mg 1.2, Al 1.5, Si 1.8, P 2.1, S 2.5, Cl 3.0; K 0.8, Ca 1.0, Br 2.8; Rb 0.8, Sr 1.0, I 2.5. Oopar ka teer daen taraf aur daen taraf ka teer oopar, dono par 'Electronegativity increases' likha hai.

Electronegativity ki qeematein jaisi Fig 1.8 mein chhapi hain

blocks.text: Aam taur par metals periodic table ke baen taraf hain aur un ki electronegativity non-metals se kam hai. Is liye nisbatan (comparatively) metals electropositive (electron dene wale) aur non-metals electronegative (electron kheenchne wale) hain.
Figure 1.9 periodic table mein elements ki mukhtalif physical properties ke tamam trends ka khulasa (summary) deti hai.

blocks.alt: Periodic table ka khaali khaaka, teeron ke saath. Oopar Ionization energy aur Electron affinity daen ki taraf; daen taraf Electron affinity aur Ionization energy oopar ki taraf. Atomic radius baen taraf neeche ki taraf aur neeche daen se baen. Table ke aar paar Nonmetallic character oopar daen aur Metallic character neeche baen ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.9: Periodic table mein mukhtalif tabee khusoosiyat (physical properties) ke rujhanaat (kitab ki Fig. 1.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer (arrow) us taraf hai jidhar woh property barhti hai. Ionization energy aur electron affinity period mein baen se daen aur group mein neeche se oopar barhti hain, is liye yeh dono oopar aur daen taraf hain. Atomic radius ulta chalta hai: group mein neeche aur period mein daen se baen barhta hai. Tirchhe teer batate hain ke non-metallic character oopar daen kone (F ki taraf) aur metallic character neeche baen kone (Cs, Fr ki taraf) barhta hai. Kitab mein 'Electon affinity' chhapa hai aur khaanon ka jaal 19 columns ka hai, period 7 adhoora; yahan sahi 'Electron affinity' aur 18 groups, 7 periods ka jaal banaya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Chhapi hui qeematon se batayein: H aur Cl ka bond zyada polar hai ya H aur Br ka? Aur period 3 ka sab se electropositive element kaun sa hai?
blocks.explanation: H–Cl zyada polar hai: chlorine (3.0) aur hydrogen (2.1) ka farq 0.9 hai, bromine (2.8) ke saath sirf 0.7. Period 3 mein sab se kam qeemat sodium (0.9) ki hai, is liye woh sab se electropositive hai.

items: Electronegativity period mein barhti (zyada nuclear charge, chhota atom) aur group mein neeche kam hoti hai (zyada shells, zyada shielding): F 4.0 se I 2.5.
Baen ke metals electropositive, daen ke non-metals electronegative; Fig 1.9 sab trends ek saath dikhati hai.
